Cotonou, Benin · Easter 2026

Easter in Cotonou

Over Easter 2026, The Tree of LIF joined Église de la Paix du Christ for a multi-day hospital outreach in Cotonou. Volunteers visited patients ward by ward, prayed with them, and helped families with medical bills.

When
Easter 2026
Where
CNHU-HKM, Cotonou, Benin
With
Église de la Paix du Christ
Who
About 30 volunteers

Day 1

Arriving at the hospital

The team met at CNHU-HKM, the national teaching hospital in Cotonou. Volunteers from The Tree of LIF and Église de la Paix du Christ wore the same shirt, with both names printed on the back.

The first photographs show the team gathering and greeting people outside the hospital.

Day 3

Ward by ward

The team visited patients ward by ward. They sat with patients and their families, prayed with them, and helped families who were facing the cost of care.

The work was simple and practical: being present, and helping with bills where they could.

Next

A beginning to build on

Easter 2026 is the first outreach documented on this site. As the work grows, the next account will be published here.
